#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int maxn = 5005;
typedef int T;
const T INF = 1e9+7;
const int K = 100;

struct Edge {
    int u, v;
    T cap, flow, cost;
};

struct MCMF {
    int n, m, s, t;
    vector<int> G[maxn];
    vector<Edge> E;
    T d[maxn];
    bool inq[maxn];
    int p[maxn];
    T a[maxn];

    explicit MCMF(int n) : n(n) {}

    void addEdge(int u, int v, T cap, T cost) {
        E.push_back({u, v, cap, 0, cost});
        E.push_back({v, u, 0, 0, -cost});
        m = (int)E.size();
        G[u].push_back(m - 2);
        G[v].push_back(m - 1);
    }

    bool BelmanFord(T &flow, T &cost) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) d[i] = INF;
        memset(inq, 0, sizeof(inq));
        d[s] = 0; inq[s] = 1; p[s] = 0; a[s] = INF;

        queue<int> Q;
        Q.push(s);
        while (!Q.empty()) {
            int u = Q.front(); Q.pop();
            inq[u] = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)G[u].size(); ++i) {
                Edge &e = E[G[u][i]];
                if (e.cap > e.flow && d[e.v] > d[u] + e.cost) {
                    d[e.v] = d[u] + e.cost;
                    p[e.v] = G[u][i];
                    a[e.v] = min(a[u], e.cap - e.flow);
                    if (!inq[e.v]) {
                        Q.push(e.v);
                        inq[e.v] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (d[t] == INF) return false;
        flow = a[t];
        cost = d[t];
        int u = t;
        while (u != s) {
            E[p[u]].flow += a[t];
            E[p[u] ^ 1].flow -= a[t];
            u = E[p[u]].u;
        }
        return true;
    }

    pair<T, T> Mincost(int s, int t) {
        this->s = s; this->t = t;
        T totalFlow = 0, totalCost = 0;
        T f = 0, d = 0;
        while (BelmanFord(f, d)) {
            totalFlow += f;
            totalCost += f * d;
        }
        return make_pair(totalFlow, totalCost);
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, m, k, C, D;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> C >> D;

    MCMF solver(n * K + 2);
    int source = n * K, sink = n * K + 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i)
        solver.addEdge(i, sink, k, C * i);

    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        x--;
        solver.addEdge(source, x * K, 1, 0);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j)
            solver.addEdge(i * K + j - 1, i * K + j, k, 0);

    for (int _ = 0; _ < m; ++_) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        u--; v--;
        for (int j = 1; j < K; ++j) {
            int a = u * K + j - 1, b = v * K + j;
            int c = v * K + j - 1, d = u * K + j;
            for (int i = 1, cc = D; i <= k; ++i, cc += 2 * D) {
                solver.addEdge(a, b, 1, cc);
                solver.addEdge(c, d, 1, cc);
            }
        }
    }
    auto result = solver.Mincost(source, sink);
    cout << result.second << endl;
}
